content: Abraham Isaacʼga ome-amisad
Abraham bato nue selebagusad. Bab-Jehová Abrahamʼgi bela ise-nueganbi binsadii gusad.
Ibagwengine, Abraham e-mai-bur-undargus-arbadiidse gochad. We-mai bela ega ibmar-dakega gudiid. Abraham a-maiga sogded: —Be anga ise-sogar-ibmar-sogegala, an-dua-urba be-argan be mese.
Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Nibneg-Dakmaid-nuggi, degi, napneg-dakmaid-nuggi ise-sogar be anga soge. Wegi, an Canaán-dulemar-abargi an maid. A-Canaán-yagan-wargwensaar mer an-machi-Isaac-onikued be sao.
Bur be an-yarse nao. Agine, an-gwenadgan-e-sisgan-wargwen, an-machi-Isaacʼga be aminao, adi, a-yagwa Isaac-nikuegar.
E-mai abin-sogded: —Nued, dummad. Ar yagwa we-negse yapa anba dagele, ¿igi an imakosunna? ¿Ar degiile, be-yargi be aligusadse, an be-machi sedsunnode?
Abraham abin-sogded: —¡Suli, mer an-machi ase be sedo!

Bab-Dummad-Jehová-Nibneg-Dakmaidi an-bab-neggi an-onosad, degi, an-babgan-yalagi an-onosbalid. A anga sogsad: ‘Napira ise-sogar an bega sogye: Emi-be-maidgi we-yala an be-waganga ukoye.’ Degisoggu, a-Bab-Dummad e-baliwitur be-idu barmidoed, adi, weba an-machiga ome be sedagegar.
Ar ome beba dagbisulile, be ise-sogar anbo igar-mesisadgi be ollorguodo. Unnila an bega soged, ¡bipisaale melle an-machi be weba sedo!
Geb degine, Abraham-e-mai, e-dummad-Abraham-dua-urba e-argan mesisgu, Abrahamʼga ise-sogar imakded, eyeye, an be-sogedba an imakoye.
Geb a-sorbali, Abraham-e-mai moli-yargan-mureged-warambe (10) susad. Abraham-ibmar-nuegan-nikad binsa-ukega susbalid. Geb degine, Mesopotamia-yarse, Nacor-neggweburse naded.
Abraham-e-mai Nacor-neggwebur-magaba modapgu, deun bato neg-sedogualid. A-wachigi omegan dii-weenad damalad. Abraham-e-mai moli-yargan-muremalad dia-naba-obunnogega sindigar osisad.
Geb degine, Abraham-e-mai Bab-Dummadse goted: “Bab-Jehováʼye, an-dummad-Abraham-e-Bab-Dummadye, emi-ibagi nued anga ibmar-gued be imakena yeerban, degine, an-dummadgi nued be binsabalina gadin.
Wegi dia-naba an siidgi, yagana-we-neggweburginmalad wese dii wedanimaloed.

A-yagwa-wargwenga an sogoedga, ‘wis be-buglu be odeye, adi, an dii gobegarye.’ A-yagwa weyob an-abinsaalile: ‘Dii be gobye, be-moli-yargan-muremaladga dii an ukmogoye.’ Agi an wisguoed, a-yagwa be-mai-Isaac-e-omega-guega be susa. Degi, be an-dummadgi-ise-nued-binsasad an wisgubaloed.”

Abraham-e-mai amba yoo Bab-Dummadse-goled bergue, dakded, yagwa-gwensak e-gukingi buglu-sii daniki. Dakleargua, we-yagwade Betuel-e-sisgwad, Rebecaʼye nugad. Betuelʼde Milca-e-machid. Milcaʼdi Nacor-e-omed. Nacorʼdi Abraham-e-urbad.
Rebeca yeer dakleged, amba yagwad, sui-sated. Rebeca diase aideded, e-buglu enosad, geb gannar nakwialid.
Agine, Abraham-e-mai gwae yagwa-abin naded. Yagwase modapgu, ega sogded: —Be-buglugi be dii-semaidi wis be anga udage.
Yagwa abin-sogded. —Dummad, be gobe. Geb degi, yog e-buglu-odear imaksad. E-argangi buglu-ganiki, diigi ogobsad.
Abraham-e-mai nue-gobsagua, Rebeca ega sogded: —Moli-yargan-muremaladga an dii weemogoed, adi, bela na dii-gobbimaladba gobmalagar.
Geb degine, yagwa e-buglugi-dii-semaidi dii-siedgi eodapid. Deyobi ichesuli nanasad, bela moli-yargan-muremalad unniguar dii gobsamaladse.
Ar Abraham-e-maidi unnila daksigusad, ar ade, nue wisgubied, e-nonikidgi bule Bab-Jehová egi nued binsasdibeye.

Bela moli-yargan-muremalad dii gobsamargua, Abraham-e-mai, yagwa-e-asugi olasu yosad. We-olasude gramo-nergwa (6) aidikued. Deginbali, sakwagi-nasikleged-olobiid, gwabo ega uksabalid. We-sakwagi-nasiklegedde gramo-dulatar (100) obinesaar aidikued.
Geb degine, Abraham-e-mai yagwaga sogded: —¿Be doa-sisgwa? Degi, anmar obunnogega, ¿be-bab-walik neg-nika be dake?
Yagwa abin-sogded: —An Betuel-sisgwa. An-babde Nacor-machid, Milcaʼbo baksadid.
Anmar-neggine bemar gabmalaga unniguar neg-nikad. Deginbali, molimar-yargan-muregedga unniguar gagan, degi, mas-maed nikabalid.
Geb degine, Abraham-e-mai yokorgi sindigar sigisad. Geb Bab-Jehováʼse goted, e-nug odummoded,

sogded: “¡Bab-Jehováʼye be-nug odummolesun! Bedi an-dummad-e-Bab-Dummadid. Bedi an-dummadgi be-sabgued, degi, be-napiragwad gwen galakudisulid. Degine, Bab-Jehováʼye be an-sealid. Be anga igar-oyosad, adi, an-dummad-e-gwenadgan-negse an warmakegar.”
Rebeca, bela ibmar-gusad e-nan-negginmaladga-sogega e-nan-negse abarmakded.
Rebecaʼde sus-nikad, Labánʼye nugad. Labán Abraham-e-mai-aminaega dia-siidse abarmakded.

E-sus e-bun-Rebeca olasu-yoi, degi, sakwagi-nasikleged-nai daksad. Degine, Labán itosbalid, igi e-bun-Rebeca machered-ega-ibmar-sogsagusadi, e-nanga sognai. Geb Labán, Abraham-e-maise naded. Abraham-e-mai, degi, moli-yargan-muremalad amba dia-walik bukwamalad.

Geb Labán Abraham-e-maiga sogded: —Bedi dule-nuedid. Begi Bab-Jehová ise-nued binsasad. ¿Ar ibiga magaba be mellesii? Be anba dage. Ar bato neg guakwaa an bemarga nudaksad, degi, be-moli-yargan-muremaladga guakwaa an neg nudaksabalid.

Geb degine, Abraham-e-mai Labánʼba negse alid. Agi, moli-yargan-muremaladgi ibmarmar-bukwad odesad. Degine, Labán a-molimarga masgunned uksad. Deginbali, Abraham-e-maiga, degi, eba-danimaladga dii senonikid, adi, nag enukmalagar.
Abraham-e-maiga mas guakwaa sisgu, Abraham-e-mai sogded: —Mas-inse an gunnosuli. Bina an bega ibmar-sogbied soggwelergebed. Labán abin-sogded: —Degite, sogdo.
Abraham-e-mai sogded: —Ani, an Abraham-e-maid.
Bab-Jehová ibiba nued an-dummadgi binsasa, mani-ibedga imaksad.
”Aginbali, e-ome-Sara, deun bato nue seleba-gusadgi, ega mimmi-baksad. An-dummad bela e-machiga ibmar uksad.
An-dummad ise-sogar-ibmar-imakega an-imaksad, anga sogsad: ‘Anmar we-Canaán-yargi-maidgi, melle an-machi e-yagan-nikuega be imakoye.
Bur an-bab-e-gwenadganse be naoye, an-gwenadgan-e-sisgan-wargwen an-machi-nikuega be aminaoye.’
”An-dummad-abin an sogsad: ‘Dummad, ¿ar yagwa yapa anba dagele, igi an saoe?’

”Geb degine, an-dummad an-abin sokalid: ‘Ani an, Bab-Jehová-igarba nanadiiye. A-Bab-Jehová e-baliwitur beba barmidoye, adi, be-naoedba bega nueganbi ibmar guegarye. Weba an-machiga an-gwenadgan-e-sisgwa be amioye, adi, nikuegarye.
Ar an-gwenadgan yapa bega e-sisgwa-ukerdina, adi, be ise-sogar-anga-sogsadi, bar beginsurye, adi, be ollorguoye.’
”Emi, deyob an diase nonisunnad. An Bab-Jehováʼse gotegu, an sogded: Bab-Jehováʼye, an-dummad-Abraham-e-Bab-Dummadye. We an nonikidse, ar napira be anga ibmar-imakoye be nue-sogele,
Bab-Jehováʼye, an wilesakwaa an bese egisye. Emi dia-naba an siidgi, weyob ibmar-gubi an abeye: Yagwa-gwensak dii-weenonikoedi, an ega sogoedga, ‘wis be-buglu be odeye, adi, an dii gobegarye.’
A-yagwa weyob an-abinsaalile: ‘Dii be gobye, be-moli-yargan-muremaladga dii an ukmogoye.’ Agi an wisguoed, a-yagwa be-mai-Isaac-e-omega-guega be susye.
”Bab-Dummadga weyob an sogsiid amba yoo an obeloge, Rebeca e-gukingi buglu-sii-daniki an dakalid. Dii-weegala diase aideded. Rebeca dii-wesgu, an ega sokalid: ‘Wis be anga dii udaye.’
“Rebeca yog e-buglu odear imaksad. Geb degi, anga sogded: ‘Dii be gobe, degine, be-moli-yargan-muremaladga dii an ukmogoed.’ Rebeca anga dii uksad, degine, an-molimarga dii uksabalid.

”Geb degine, an ese egichided: ‘¿Be doa-sisgwa?’ ”Bunagwa an-abin imaksad: ‘An Betuel-sisgwaye. An-babde Nacor-machiye, Milcaʼbo baksadye.’ ”Geb degine, an ega e-asugi olasu yosad, geb deginbali, e-sakwamargi sakwagi-nasikleged an ega nasiksabalid.

Geb degi, yokorgi sindigar an sigisad. Geb degine, Bab-Jehováʼse an goted, Bab-Jehová-nug an odummoded. Bab-Jehová an-dummad-Abraham-e-Bab-Dummadga gumogad. A-e-nug an odummoded, igar-nuedba an-senonikidba an e-nug odummoded. Adi, an-dummad-e-urba-e-sisgwa an-dummad-machi-e-omega guegar.”
Abraham-e-mai sogdebalid: —Ar emigindi, be anga nue sogmalo, an-dummadgi bemar nued, degi, napiragwadgi binsaodibe. Ar deyobsulile, bemar nue anga sogmarbalo, adi, an wisgubaloed, igi an imakoe.
Geb degine, Labán, Betuel-ebo abin-sogdemalad: —We-ibmar bela Bab-Jehováʼgi danikid. Degisoggu, geg anmar bega soged eyeye, geg an bega sogbalid surye.
Wegi Rebeca gwichi, be sede. Bab-Jehová-sogsadba, Rebeca be sedo, adi, be-dummad-machi-e-omega guegar.
Abraham-e-mai deyob-ega-soge-itosgu, Bab-Jehová-asabin yokorgi sindigar sigided, napase e-bebe-ebulegedse dulluu imaksabalid.
Geb degine, Abraham-e-mai ibmar-bukidar onosad: Olomar, manimar, degi, mormar. Geb Rebecaʼga uksad. Deginbali, Abraham-e-mai Rebeca-e-susga, degi, e-nanga ibmar-bukidar binsa uksabalid.

A-sorbali, Abraham-e-mai, degi, eba-gudidimalad mas guchamalad, gobsamalad, degine, geb gabismalad. Oibosgua, Abraham-e-mai gwisgusgua, sogded: —Emi, anmar gannar an-dummad-negse-naega be anmar-imaksun.
Ar Rebeca-e-sus, degi, e-nana, sogdemalad: —Bunagwa anmar-walik napi-ibambe (10) gudii guoye. Geb a-sorbali, naoye.
Abraham-e-maidi abin-sogded: —Melle bar an-igar gamalo. We-an-bese-nonikidi Bab-Jehová bela ibmar-nueganbi-guega imaksad. Degisoggu, gannar an-dummad-negse-naed be an-imakmarsun.
Geb degine, Abraham-e-mai-abin sogdemalad: —Anmar bunagwase gormalo, ar bunagwade igi sogdamogodibe.
Rebecaʼse gochamalad, ese egisdemalad: —¿Emisgwa we-macheredba be nabie? Bunagwa abin-sogded. —Eye, an nabie.
Geb degine, Rebeca-barmismarsunnad, degi, ome-gusgu-Rebeca-akwedidaedi eba nadmogad. Abraham-e-mai, degi, eba-gudidimalad nadmarmogad.
Rebeca-e-gwenadgan Rebecaʼgi ise-nued binsadmalad, weyob ega sogdemalad:
Geb degine, Rebeca, degi, Rebeca-e-maimar moli-yargan-muregedgi nakwismarsunnad, Abraham-e-mai-sorba nadap gusmalad. Weyobi, Abraham-e-mai Rebeca-sesa nadsunnad.
Deunni, Isaacʼdi dia-Lajay-Roíʼye-nugadse-gudii danikid, ar ade, Neguevʼye-neg-nugadgi maid.
Isaac deunni sedogidbali binsa sapurba wis garmakdii sanaded. Agi dakalid, moli-yargan-muremalad daniki.
Rebeca atakdemogu, Isaac-dani dakalid. Agine, Rebeca, moli-yargan-mureged-birgi-siidgi aideded.
Geb degine, Abraham-e-maise egichided: —Dule sapurba anmarsik-danikidi, ¿we doa-dule? Abraham-e-mai Rebeca-abin sogded. —We an-dummadi. Geb degi, Rebeca e-muswe susad. Geb e-wagar odukusad.
Geb degine, Abraham-e-mai e-ibmar-imaksad bela Isaacʼga sogsad.

Geb degi, Isaac e-nan-dordonegyaba Rebeca-sesad. Agi, na nikusmalad. Geb degine, Isaac Rebeca-nue-sabe gusad. Isaac, Rebeca-nikadba yeer-itodii gusad, a-ulale, e-nan-Sara-burgwisadgi wis baisur-itosad.
